evidence.reason: `render_units` recursively collects matching templates from the pinned tree (including nested paths) and flattens them into `output / source.name`. Two templates in different subdirectories with the same basename therefore overwrite each other, and the returned `paths` contains the same target twice; the first template is silently lost. Duplicate-basename detection before writing is a routine correctness fix; unique basenames continue to render normally.
